FX-SPGLOW-001.says: Spectral on at its defaults (red 80, green 100, blue 120 per cent), radius 12, everything else at Soft Physical Glow's defaults: red stays closer to each patch and blue reaches further, so the tail turns bluer outward.

FX-SPGLOW-002.says: Spectral on, all three at 100: the same as Soft Physical Glow with Spectral off (FX-SGLOW-001).

FX-SPGLOW-003.says: Spectral off written in the file, with sizes set: Soft Physical Glow as before (FX-SGLOW-001).

FX-SPGLOW-004.says: Spectral on, radius 100, red 50, green 100, blue 200: a strong fringe, the blue tail far wider than the red.

FX-SPGLOW-005.says: Spectral on, red 200, green 100, blue 50, the other way round: a red tail outside a blue core.

FX-SPGLOW-006.says: Spectral on, red 0: red does not spread at all, the light laid on itself only; green and blue glow as before.

FX-SPGLOW-007.says: Spectral on with the grey drawing: the grey patch, white light, glows white close in and fringes in colour further out.

FX-SPGLOW-008.says: Spectral on with Tint Core to Edge: each channel's levels tinted at its own radius, then the channels taken one from each.

FX-SPGLOW-009.says: Spectral on with Tint One Colour orange at 60 per cent, Threshold 30 and Smooth 50 in Luminance.

FX-SPGLOW-010.says: Blue keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 200 at frame 4, linear, red and green at 100: frame 0 is FX-SPGLOW-002, frame 2 has blue at 150.

FX-SPGLOW-011.says: Spectral on, Blend Mode Add, exposure 3: the fringed light adds up past white.

FX-SPGLOW-012.says: Spectral on, Unmult off, Source Opacity 0: the fringed glow alone, on black.

FX-SPGLOW-013.says: Spectral on, Aspect Ratio 1.5 at Angle 30, moved three pixels right.

FX-SPGLOW-014.says: Spectral on, radius 2.25, red 50, blue 200: red has no level (radius 1.125), green one half-in level, blue two.

FX-SPGLOW-015.says: Spectral on, radius 2,000, red 50, blue 200: blue's radius 4,000, past Radius's own top, is worked as it is.

FX-SPGLOW-016.says: Spectral on, the patches half covering: the light counts at half.

FX-SPGLOW-017.says: Spectral "yes", which is not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
